title: Islamic Habit Tracker
description: It is an Islamic habit-building & tracker app that facilitates the daily worship of Muslims. In this unique application, which we have carefully worked and prepared for you, you will find the following. Habit Trackers, Routine Planners, Holy Quran, Prayer Times, Qibla Finder, Ramadan Calendar, Rosary Counter, Prayer and Ablution Guide. This app combines many features that make the daily prayers of Muslims easier. These features include: 🌙 Optimize Your Ramadan Worship: Sahur, Iftar & Tarawih Tracking! Make the most of Ramadan with features designed to enhance your spiritual journey. Stay on top of your Sahur and Iftar times with accurate reminders, ensuring you never miss a meal before or after fasting. Plan and track your Tarawih prayers effortlessly, and follow the Ramadan timeline to stay organized throughout the holy month. Strengthen your faith with daily Quran recitations, dhikr tracking, and prayer reminders, making your Ramadan worship more structured and fulfilling. 🤲🏻Prayer Times: This feature shows the prayer times(namaz time) according to your location. So you will not miss your prayers. 📖Quran Reading: This feature allows you to read the Quran. You can choose the whole Quran or any surah or verse and discover all the beauties of Islam. 📿Prayer and ablution guide: This feature offers guidance on prayer and ablution. The app shows you how to pray tracker, which prayers to recite and under what conditions, how to perform ablution and in what order. So you can perform your prayer and ablution more accurately. You can also find the qibla direction using qibla compass. 🧭Qibla finder: Qibla compass and qibla direction feature allows you to find the qibla direction. The app shows the direction of Qibla using your phone's compass. So you can determine the place where you will pray. 🗓️Ramadan timeline: This feature shows the start and end dates of Ramadan, the times for suhoor and iftar, and the days when fasting is obligatory. So you can plan Ramadan better. 🖼️Islamic themes: This feature allows you to change your app's background, colors and fonts according to Islamic themes. So you can personalize the look of your app. 🎶Islamic ringtones: This feature allows you to set your app's sounds to sounds related to Islam. The app offers sounds such as adhan, quran, prayer, hymns. For Muslims, worship is the most important part of life. Performing acts of worship such as prayer, fasting, zakat and pilgrimage are necessary to gain Allah's approval and to be happy in the hereafter. However, it can sometimes be difficult to know how, when and under what conditions to perform these acts of worship. That's why we have developed this Islam 360 application to help you. Discover a holistic approach to your spiritual journey with the enhanced Islamic Habit Tracker and Routine Planner app. Our new features include the Quran, providing easy access to the holy text. Stay organized with the Monthly Timetable, ensuring you never miss an important event. The Tasbeeh Counter helps you keep track of your dhikr. Our Prayer Tracking feature allows you to monitor and make up missed prayers. Find the nearest mosque effortlessly with Nearby Mosque. Get inspired daily with Daily Dua and Daily Ayat, featuring verses from the Quran. Finally, the Qibla Finder ensures you always pray in the right direction. Strengthen your faith and habits with Islamic Habit Tracker. Muslim's prayer times is an app to help Muslims pray tracker more easily and accurately. This application works on both smartphones and tablets.We have designed it for you to form habit-building for daily prayers. We would like it to be a part of your life as an islamic apps application that facilitates the worship of Muslims. Download this prayer times app, make your prayers more beautiful and receive Allah's mercy and blessings.
